title: Small Line Divan Bed – Upholstered Divan Bed UK
descriptionHtml:
Want a complete upholstered divan set at a sensible price? The Small Line Divan Bed pairs subtle small line panel headboard detailing with a firm platform divan base, giving a clean, contemporary bedroom look. It is handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, from £259.99 in Single 3ft to £399.99 in Super King 6ft, with free delivery across Great Britain.

Key features

  • Small line panel headboard design
  • Firm platform divan base
  • Quality upholstered fabric throughout
  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches so you can choose your colour with confidence

Sizes

  • Single (3FT): £259.99
  • Small Double (4FT): £285.99
  • Standard Double (4FT6): £299.99
  • King (5FT): £324.99
  • Super King (6FT): £399.99

Not sure which size you need? See our UK bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Built on a solid wood frame and fully upholstered by hand. Fabrics: Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé, in solid colours, stripes or two-tone finishes, with custom fabric and colour options available on request.

Mattress compatibility

The firm platform top takes a standard UK mattress in the size you order. Browse our mattresses, such as the 2000 Pocket Sprung Pillow Top Mattress. This base is a platform divan without built-in storage; for storage see our ottoman beds.

Customisation

Choose solid colours, stripes or two-tone, or ask about a custom fabric and colour. Free swatches are available.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Every Eagle Bed is made to order in our Pepproyd Street workshop in Dewsbury. Delivery is free across Great Britain by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90. You have 14 days for free returns (we collect it free) if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. Faulty items get a free replacement or a full refund. Every bed has a 5-year warranty, and you can spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay.

Want drawers instead? See the Divan Storage Base with Drawers, browse all divan beds, or read divan bed vs bed frame.

FAQ

Does the Small Line Divan Bed include a headboard?

Yes, it is a divan set with a small line panel headboard.

Does it have storage?

No, it has a firm platform base. For storage choose an ottoman or drawer divan.

Can I see the fabric before I order?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available so you can check colour and texture at home.

Is delivery really free?

Yes, across Great Britain, usually in 3–5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90.

What is your returns policy?

14 days for free returns if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging.

Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Not sure on colour? Order free fabric swatches and see the fabric at home before you buy.
